verses.1: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith.
verses.2: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise
verses.3: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place —
verses.4: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
verses.5: You made him a little lower than the angels;
verses.6: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
verses.7: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
verses.8: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
verses.9: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
